summary: Executed source SQL composite-read snapshot controls on SQLite and remote PostgreSQL 16.14. Real second-connection commits during project/version edits, project deletion, joint job/result deletion and security-event publication cannot mix exported record generations. Dynamic repository selection, isolation settings, ambient-transaction refusal, rollback and connection-state release are checked. JSON is regression-only; installed GUI, external artifacts, full backups and large-export performance remain open.

required_text: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY
keeps model and version collections from one generation
keeps job and result collections from one joint commit
keeps a project removed after its first model read
database security events share the same snapshot
a query failure discards partial data and releases the transaction
the snapshot uses the selected dynamic repository
public exports refuse an ambient transaction
PostgreSQL rejects accidental writes within the read-only snapshot
